# dsh-reasoning-picker
A composer button for DeepSeek Harness that answers one question before you hit send: **how much mod
el do I actually need for this draft?**
Click the 📊 button next to the send action. The plugin reads your draft (plus the last few turns of
the conversation), asks a cheap model to judge the difficulty, and shows a recommendation — **Flash*
* or **Pro**, plus the reasoning effort, plus a one-line reason. Nothing changes until you click **应
用 (Apply)**, and it never sends the message for you.
The point is to stop paying for `Pro · High` on "rename this variable" while still getting `Pro` whe
n the task deserves it.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then restart DSH (or reload the page) so the client half is loaded. The button appears in the compos
er toolbar, to the right of the input box.
## How it works
| Step | What happens |

| 1 | You type a draft and click 📊 |
| 2 | The host reads the draft and the last few messages of the

session |
| 3 | A small model picks the cheapest level that fits, from a ladder built from the mode

ls you actually have |
| 4 | A small panel shows `Flash · Off` / `Pro · Low` … plus a one-line reaso

n |
| 5 | You click **应用** — only then is that provider/model/effort applied to the current session

|
| 5 | You click **应用** — only then is that provider/model/effort applied to the current session |

- **Never auto-sends.** The draft stays in the box; you still press send.
- **Never auto-switches.**

Evaluating alone changes nothing.
- **Uses your own model list.** The ladder is built from what `se
ssionController.modelCatalog()` reports, so it adapts to whatever providers you configured instead o

f assuming fixed tiers.
- The evaluator runs at the lowest effort the chosen model supports, so the
estimate itself costs almost nothing.
## Configuration
The plugin works with zero configuration. Optional keys (in the bundle config):
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `flashModel` / `flashProvider` | auto-detect | Force the "cheap" tier |
| `proModel` / `proProvide

r` | auto-detect | Force the "strong" tier |
| `maxRecentMessages` | `6` | How many recent messages

are fed to the evaluator |
| `maxRecentChars` | `1400` | Character budget for that recent context |

| `maxDraftChars` | `4000` | Draft is truncated to this length |
| `timeoutMs` | `15000` | Evaluator

tChars` | `4000` | Draft is truncated to this length |
| `timeoutMs` | `15000` | Evaluator timeout |
## Privacy & safety

- Both HTTP routes are loopback-only and reject forwarded/origin-mismatched requests.
- The draft an
d recent context are sent to the model you already use through DSH's own `llm` service — no third-pa

rty endpoint.
- No telemetry, no network calls other than the model call you configured.
